On The 21 st Of July, 2023
 Misc. Criminal Case No. 31552 of 2023
 Between:-
 Vijay S/O Shri Hariram Kushwaha, Aged About
 20 Years, Occupation: Labour Vill.

Kuluwa Ka
 Khirak Barua P.S Niwadi (Madhya Pradesh)
 
 (By Shri Sunil Kumar Mishra, Advocate)

And
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh Through P.S
 Mahila Police Thana Niwadi Distt. Niwadi
 (Madhya Pradesh)

(BY SHRI AJIT RAWAT, GOVT. ADVOCATE)
 This application coming on for admission this day, t  following:
 ORDER 1.

This is first bail application filed under Section 439 CrPC on behalf of applicant who is in custody since 7.4.2023 in connection with Crime No.14/2023 registered at Police Station Mahila Thana,
District Niwadi (M.P.), for the offence punishable under sections 376(2)(n) and 315 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 5/6 of POCSO Act.
2. Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that prosecutrix is aged about 17 years and she was consenting party.
There is delay in lodging of F.I.R. F.I.R was lodged when prosecutrix was pregnant.
In these circumstances, applicant may be enlarged on bail.
3. Learned Govt. Advocate appearing for the respondent/State opposed the prayer for grant of bail.
He read over her statement recorded under section 164 CrPC in which prosecutrix has stated that applicant had forcefully committed rape on her.
In these circumstances he may not be released on bail.

sentences.text: 4. Heard the learned counsel for the parties.
5. In initial statement to police, prosecutrix has not made any allegation of forceful rape.
Later on in subsequent statement she had made statement that she was forcefully raped by applicant.
6. Considering the age of prosecutrix and the statement which is recorded by police, bail application filed by the applicant is allowed.

7. It is directed that applicant shall be released on bail on his furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court for his appearance before the trial court on the dates to be fixed by the trial court.

8. The applicant shall abide by the conditions enumerated under Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C.
C.C as per rules.
